content: The sixth “NUclear physics School for Young Scientists (NUSYS2026)” will be held at Beijing, China from August 9 to August 16 , 2026（ Registration on the 9th, departure on the 16th ） hosted by Beihang University. Participants are expected to arrive and check in on August 9. The goal of this school is to motivate the PhD students and postdoctoral/young researchers by introducing them to the various facets of the nuclear physics and its applications to the nuclear science and technology, as well as the future prospects of the forthcoming nuclear facilities in Asia. Experts worldwide are invited to convey a view of the rich variety of present on-going activities in the field of experimental and theoretical nuclear physics and to exploit the opportunities created by the on-going or the next-generation nuclear physics facilities particularly in Asia, such as HIAF (High Intensity heavy-ion Accelerator Facility), JUNA (Jinping Underground Nuclear Astrophysics), SLEGS (Shanghai Laser Electron Gamma Source) and BISOL (Beijing Isotope-Separation On-Line neutron-rich beam facility) which are either operational or planned in China, RAON (Rare isotope Accelerator complex for ON-line experiment) in South Korea and RIBF (Radioactive Isotope Beam Factory) in Japan. Each student is required to contribute by presenting a poster related to her/his work . The organizing committee together with invited lecturers will select the six best posters for the oral presentation session at the school, and three students will be awarded with “ANPhA Award for Young Scientists” and three for “NUSYS Award for Young Scientists”. Registration The application is now open and will be closed on July 9, 2026 . The application form (to be completed by the student) can be found at the school website( https://indico.impcas.ac.cn/e/nusys ). An abstract for the poster and a statement including self-introduction, motivation, and the expectation from attending NUSYS2026 are required, which can be filled online. A recommendation letter needs to be sent directly to the school email address: ircbbc@buaa.edu.cn to support the application . The total number of participants for PhD students and postdoctoral/young researchers will be limited to 50. Participants will be selected by the organization committee. Our target participants are mainly PhD students and young postdoctoral researchers. A confirmation letter will be sent to each selected participant via email. The registration fee is 1,500 RMB (cash only) , which covers lunch coupons and coffee breaks. Partial financial support (waive registration fees) may be available for students who require assistance to attend the conference. If you need support, please send a request to the school email address ( ircbbc@buaa.edu.cn ). Accommodation Please note that this year, the organizing committee will NOT coordinate official hotel bookings. Participants are kindly requested to make their own accommodation arrangements. Nearby hotels are: Vision Hotel Beijing (Weishi Jiudian, No. 39 Xueyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing, China) Wuke Hotel: http://www.bjwkhotel.com Atour Hotel (Beijing Zhongguancun Academy): Ji Hotel (Beijing Xueyuanqiao): For your reference, you can find information about the past schools at NUSYS2019: https://indico.ihep.ac.cn/event/9962/ NUSYS2022: https://indico.ihep.ac.cn/event/14252/ NUSYS2023: https://indico.ihep.ac.cn/event/19097/ NUSYS2024: https://indico.ihep.ac.cn/event/21760/ NUSYS2025: https://indico.ihep.ac.cn/event/25165/ Poster Requirement It is recommended that all participants prepare posters sized 80 cm × 120 cm. Please print your poster on your own and bring it with you for attendance at the meeting. Sponsor Poster

3.涉及科研伦理与科技安全的项目，申请人需严格执行国家法律法规和伦理准则，并按照要求提供相关附件。 三、申请规定 申请人同年只能申请1项项目；获得兰州重离子加速器国家实验室高端用户项目资助且在执行期内的项目负责人，不得作为申请人申请新的项目。 1.重点项目：支持在兰州重离子研究装置上已有较好基础的研究方向开展系统性、创新性研究，促进学科发展，推动关键领域取得重大突破。重点评价项目的科学意义和研究价值。 项目支持经费40万元，项目周期2年。 2.培育项目：支持青年科技人员（40周岁以下）独立主持科研项目、进行创新研究，激励青年科技人员的创新思维，培养兰州重离子加速器国家实验室新用户。重点评价申请人的创新潜力。 登陆中国科学院重大科技基础设施共享服务平台（http://lssf.cas.cn/）在线填报申请。 2. 空间科学领域用户 填写“兰州重离子加速器国家实验室束流申请书（空间科学领域）”（附件1），发送电子版（word格式）至hirfl@impcas.ac.cn，待收到反馈意见后，邮寄签字盖章版2份至兰州重离子加速器国家实验室办公室。 三、申请须知 填写申请前，用户应认真阅读《兰州重离子加速器国家实验室束流申请指南》（附件2）。 本次束流申请批复机时有效期为2024年9月至2025年7月。 用户可填写“兰州重离子研究装置（HIRFL）用户成果统计表”（附件3）报送研究成果。 三、联系方式 邮寄地址：甘肃省兰州市城关区天水中路8号 联 系 人：毛老师 18509312985 邮 箱：hirfl@impcas.ac.cn
